verdict.rationale: Skyvern's own GitHub README says its agent maps visual elements to actions, which points to a vision-based approach to page interaction. Nothing in the evidence documents a switchable vision or computer-use mode, coordinate or screenshot-driven actions, or handling of canvas UIs that the DOM path can't reach. The CAPTCHA vision model is a separate feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented selectable vision/computer-use action mode, screenshot/coordinate-based action primitives, explicit canvas or non-DOM UI support, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can switch to a vision or computer-use action mode that operates on screenshots for canvases and UIs the DOM path can't handle

citations.quote: it's able to map visual elements to actions necessary to complete a workflow, without any customized code
